messages:
maria: Heads-up: preparing delta split build for v2.3.1-rc3 for onprem. Need tagging + fallback image pinned for VPC customers.
kevin: ETA on artifacts? Any cosign signer changes?
package-ops: Uploading delta bundles now -> will tag `rc3-delta-split-2026-03-21`. Publishing both delta and full.
deploy-bot: deploybot: packaging job queued (job_id=pkgr-9832)
package-ops: Shrinkwrap will yield two tarballs: `installer-delta.tar.gz` (diff) and `installer-full.tar.gz` (fallback). We'll push delta to mirrors first.
sylvia: For canary, can we pin canary hosts to the `rc3-delta` tag and keep full as `rc3-fallback`?
package-ops: Yep. Plan: canary uses `rc3-delta-split` tag, fallback tag `rc3-full-fallback-20260321`.
kevin: Cosign: we need signer rotation window — I'm reusing the staging KMS key. Command: `cosign sign --key $KMS_URI installer-delta.tar.gz`.
package-ops: Signed. Digest `sha256:abcd1234ef...`. Uploading signatures to signer-bucket now.
deploy-bot: deploybot: canary push started -> subset=10 hosts region=us-west-2
ops-oncall: Watch for registry throttle. If 429s spike, we'll pause canary and fallback to full image.
sylvia: Remind infra: prefix caching must be disabled for delta installs to avoid stale layers.
kevin: Noted. Disabling prefix-cache for canary groups now.
package-ops: Canary succeeded on first batch. Noting a flaky post-install hook on 1/10 hosts (timeout). Investigating.
maria: What's the failure? Can we roll to full for those hosts?
package-ops: It's the metrics-agent post-install; we pushed a retry fix. Retrying on the 1/10.
package-ops: Retry succeeded on second attempt. Marking canary green.
sylvia: Rolling to remaining clusters in 30m window. Keep fallback pin ready.
kevin: Prep rollback playbook: if >5% failures across next 3 batches, run `rollback-to rc2-stable` and revoke delta tags.
ops-oncall: I'll stand by. Setting alert rule `install.fail.rate > 0.05` for next 6 hours.
package-ops: Finalizing release notes: `v2.3.1-rc3 (onprem) - delta split rollout; use rc3-full-fallback if issues`. Pushing notes to release channel after cut.
maria: Thanks all. Tagging legal for audit artifacts.
deploy-bot: deploybot: packaging job complete. artifacts: `installer-delta.tar.gz` -> s3://private-bundles/rc3-delta-split-20260321
